#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <utility>
#include <climits>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;
typedef long long LL;
LL n, A[20], B[20], ans;
#define FOR(i, a, b) for (int i = (a); i <= (b); i++)
typedef pair<LL, LL> P;

void dfs(int pos, LL now, LL res) {
	if (res >= ans) return;
	if (pos == 0) {
		if (!now) ans = res;
		return;
	}
	int t = now / A[pos];
	int d = abs(t) - 1;
	if (t < 0) d = -d;
	int s = abs(t) + 1;
	if (t < 0) s = -s;
	dfs(pos - 1, now - t * B[pos], res + abs(t) * pos);
	dfs(pos - 1, now - d * B[pos], res + abs(d) * pos);
	dfs(pos - 1, now - s * B[pos], res + abs(s) * pos);
}

int main() {
	FOR(i, 1, 16) B[i] = B[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
	A[1] = 1;
	FOR(i, 2, 16) A[i] = A[i - 1] * 10;
	cin >> n;
	LL m = n;
	int c = 0;
	while (m) {
		c++;
		m /= 10;
	}
	ans = LLONG_MAX;
	dfs(c, n, 0);
	dfs(c, B[c + 1] - n, c + 1);
	cout << ans << endl;
	return 0;
}
